    Add circular reference tests for dependency resolver
    
    The dependency graph's recursive methods (transitive_dependents,
    compute_skips, topological_order, find_cycle, parallel_groups) had
    no test coverage for circular reference scenarios. A cycle in the
    dependency graph could theoretically cause infinite loops in the
    traversal code.
    
    These 17 new tests verify that:
    - Self-cycles, 2-node, 3-node, and 10-node cycles are detected
    - topological_order and parallel_groups return CircularDependency errors
    - transitive_dependents and compute_skips terminate on cyclic graphs
      (protected by HashSet visited tracking)
    - find_cycle correctly isolates the cyclic subgraph
    - is_ready correctly reports no step in a cycle can ever be ready
    - Error messages include all participating cycle members
